 There are nine games in the Champions League on Wednesday, and BBC Sport will bring you every moment.
 AEK Athens v Real Madrid (17:45)
 Fenerbahce v Liverpool (17:45)
 Borussia Dortmund v Real Betis
 Lens v Como
 PSV Eindhoven v Club Brugge
 Porto v Napoli
 RB Leipzig v Manchester City
 Slavia Prague v Arsenal
 Viking v Sabah
 Kick-off times 20:00 GMT unless stated 
 Follow all of the action and reaction here 
 Listen to an around the grounds service from 19:55 on Wednesday on BBC Radio 5 live and BBC Sounds . 
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Watch highlights of every Champions League game from 22:00 on BBC iPlayer and the BBC Sport website and app. 
 There will also be a Champions League Match of the Day on BBC One from 22:40 to 00:00.
